name: kishmish
description: See the new job postings that fit you at the companies you watch, and manage your Kishmish companies, criteria and digest from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Kishmish watches the careers pages of the companies you choose and scores every new posting against your own plain-language criteria, so you only see the roles worth your time.

With Kishmish in ChatGPT you can:
- See your matching roles, best fit first, each with an AI-estimated fit score, a one-line reason it fits, and a link to the posting
- Add or remove the companies you watch
- Read or rewrite your matching criteria
- Change how often your digest email arrives, pause it, or set a minimum fit score
- Re-scan your companies right away after changing your criteria

Who it's for: people keeping an eye on a shortlist of companies who want to hear about new openings that fit them, without checking careers pages every day.

Limitations: you sign in to your Kishmish account when you connect. Kishmish tracks companies that hire through Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, TeamTailor or BambooHR. Fit scores are AI estimates, so check each posting yourself. Kishmish doesn't apply to jobs or contact employers for you.
defaultPrompt: Any new roles for me today?
Show my best job matches from the past month.
Help me set up Kishmish to watch companies I like.

positive.description: List recent matches, best fit first
positive.prompt: Show my best job matches from the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's matching roles from the last 30 days, highest fit first. Each role has its title, company, location, a fit percentage, a one-line reason it fits, and a link that opens the posting on the company's job board.

positive.description: See watched companies and add one
positive.prompt: Which companies is Kishmish watching for me? Also start watching Linear.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the companies the demo account watches, then adds Linear and confirms it with its job board (Ashby) and how many roles it has open. If Linear is already watched from an earlier review, says it's already being watched.

positive.prompt: Update my Kishmish criteria so remote roles anywhere in Europe also count.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current criteria, saves the full criteria text with remote roles in Europe added, and confirms the update. update_criteria is marked destructive (it overwrites the criteria), so ChatGPT may ask for confirmation first, depending on the user's settings.

positive.prompt: Send my Kishmish digest weekly instead, and only include roles that are at least a 70% fit.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the digest frequency to weekly and the minimum fit to 70%, then confirms the new settings. update_settings is marked destructive (it overwrites settings), so ChatGPT may ask for confirmation first, depending on the user's settings. get_settings may also be called to show them.

positive.prompt: Re-scan my companies now and tell me if anything new matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs a re-scan (can take up to a minute) and reports how many companies were checked, how many postings were re-scored and how many new matches were found, then lists recent matches. If the hourly re-scan limit is reached, says when to try again.

negative.description: Applying to jobs is out of scope: Kishmish has no tool that applies or sends anything to employers. Expected: no tool call changes anything; ChatGPT explains it can't apply and offers the posting link so the user can apply themselves.
negative.prompt: Apply to my top Kishmish match for me and send them my CV.

negative.description: Other people's data: every tool is scoped to the signed-in account and takes no user or email argument. Expected: ChatGPT explains it can only see the connected account's matches and doesn't return anyone else's.
negative.prompt: Show me the Kishmish job matches for alice@example.com.

negative.description: Billing is out of scope: there are no plan or payment tools. Expected: no tool call; ChatGPT says plan changes are made in Kishmish's own settings.

review.commerce_description: Kishmish doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: see your job matches with fit scores and links, rate matches to tune future scoring, manage the companies you watch, edit your matching criteria and digest settings, and re-scan on demand.
